challenges.scope: Configured potential allowance for exactly three simultaneous sorts per admitted nonparallel transaction.
challenges.plan: No hardware SKU is assumed. The given 1024-MiB dedicated sort allowance and measured 64-MiB work_mem minimum are scenario inputs, not platform defaults.
challenges.role: The application owns admission control and authorized transaction-local tuning; neither action reserves a universal server-wide memory pool.
challenges.preconditions: No hashes, no parallel plan workers, exactly three simultaneous sorts, and all other memory separately budgeted explicitly bound the model.
challenges.featureStatus: Ordinary work_mem and SET LOCAL semantics apply. No hash-multiplier setting, privileged extension or preview memory feature is assumed.
challenges.sourceChanges: Re-read the admitted pg-tune and pg-pool sections. The old supplemental hash-memory defect receipt remains unapproved and unnecessary: the revised scope excludes hashes and parallel plans rather than silently assuming favorable multipliers.
challenges.stemSufficiency: Both independent bounds can be evaluated: each sort needs at least 64 MiB, and all simultaneous configured sort allowances must fit 1024 MiB.
challenges.explanationBounds: Five×three×64=960 MiB is the bounded sort allowance. This is not guaranteed immediate allocation or total observed server memory; LOCAL supplies scope, not admission enforcement.
challenges.reasoningDepth: Advanced is authentic: combine a per-operation measured minimum, concurrency and a dedicated upper allowance while distinguishing local setting scope from admission.
challenges.answerClues: Each alternative makes a real different concurrency/memory tradeoff; neither larger work_mem nor more admitted requests is automatically better.

adversarial.qualityNotes: The explicit simplifying bounds are lengthy but necessary; clarity 3 reflects terminology/load rather than a hidden resource assumption. The v1 hash/parallel defect is actually removed. This revision preserves one concurrent-sort budgeting fact, distinct from storage-byte accounting, live-index growth and shared-buffer working sets.
